blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Chief Justice Artemio Panganiban said on Wednesday that if he were a senator-judge who had failed to actively participate in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, he would inhibit himself from the proceedings. During discussions on whether the number of votes needed to convict Duterte should be lowered based on a lower total number of Senate members, Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros asked Panganiban what would be the right course of action for someone who had taken their oath but failed to attend the proceedings.
